description:
Activate Scorched Rusalka by paying {R} and sacrificing Gleaming Barrier.
Gleaming Barrier dies, triggering itself, it's undying ability and Luminous Broodmoth.
Resolve the first Gleaming Barrier trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Luminous Broodmoth trigger, returning Gleaming Barrier from your graveyard to the battlefield with a flying counter on it.
Resolve the second Gleaming Barrier trigger, failing to return it to the battlefield.
Resolve the Scorched Rusalka ability from step 1, dealing 1 damage to target player or planeswalker.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Activate Scorched Rusalka by paying {R} and sacrificing Gleaming Barrier.
Gleaming Barrier dies, triggering itself and it's undying ability.
Resolve the first Gleaming Barrier trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the second Gleaming Barrier trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Scorched Rusalka ability from step 8, dealing 1 damage to target player or planeswalker.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Activate Scorched Rusalka by paying {R} and sacrificing Gleaming Barrier.
Gleaming Barrier dies, triggering itself and Luminous Broodmoth.
Resolve the first Gleaming Barrier trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Luminous Broodmoth trigger, returning Gleaming Barrier from your graveyard to the battlefield with a flying counter on it.
 Repeat from step 6.
